Name: (WIP) Dateable Gunther for SVE
Author: MariqueAltariah
Description:
This mod lets you romance and marry Gunther (Stardew Valley Expanded version) ! It adds dialogue alongside his vanilla lines, as well as a new sprite (optional). Everything is [b]SFW [/b]!

It's my first mod ever, and still a [b]work in progress[/b] (see the [color=#76a5af][b]Improvements needed[/b] [/color]section). 

[size=1](as long as my hyperfixation doesn't wear out)[/size]

Please do not hesitate to make me know about any misspelling or any weird grammar as English is not my native language ! Thank you for your comprehension.

[color=#6aa84f][size=4][b]Features: 
[/b][/size]
- Gunther can socialize before you donate 60 items to the museum.
- Dating and marriage 
- Spouse schedule
- Spouse room
- Spouse patio
- Optional new sprite (you can deactivate it from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config menu[/url] in-game, or by editing the config.json file (just replace the term "new"with "vanilla". default is "new").
- Compatibility of the new sprite with Poltergeister's [color=#6aa84f][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] [/color]

- New dialogue based on friensdhip level + spouse dialogue. [/color]

[color=#e06666]

- This mod is [b]NOT a SVE conversion of [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]WerewolfMaster's Make Gunther Real[/url] mod. This is a different mod, though I reused some of their dialogue. [/color]

[color=#76a5af]
[b][size=4]Improvements needed :[/size]
[/b]
- needs parenting related dialogue (Gunther might say default dialogue lines instead). I'd gladly accept help on that !
- needs adjusting the heart-events dialogues and sprites, as it currently uses SVE's vanilla ones. (for example Gunther might seem suddenly less friendly during an event compared to your actual friendship level)
[/color]
[color=#76a5af]
- no 10 and 14 heart events at the moment [size=1]( yeah I definetly knew there were such things as >10 hearts hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha)[/size][/color][color=#f6b26b]

[b][size=4]Known issues: [/size]
[/b]
- Gunther appears angry while saying certain vanilla lines. I did change the portrait asset, but I also changed the portrait commands ($5 -> $3) accordingly, so I don't understand why he still looks angry lol[/color]
